text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) of dairy system conversion in France focusing on environmental impacts, particularly climate change and land use consequences, using economic models (GTAP and LEITAP) to estimate land use change (LUC) impacts. However, it does not perform explicit spatially-explicit national-scale LULC prediction or simulation with mapped projections. The LUC analysis is based on global economic model outputs aggregated at broad regional levels and used as impact factors rather than spatially explicit or mapped LULC predictions. There is no implementation of ≥2 future spatial scenarios with quantitative spatial accuracy metrics or mapped outputs. The primary focus is on environmental impact assessment (GHG emissions and land occupation) rather than on LULC prediction or simulation as a central research question. Hence, it fails the core inclusion criteria requiring explicit national-scale spatial implementation, spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics, and mapped LULC projections.)
